issues.description: Inconsistent return type for the same method across template and solution: `de.tum.in.ase.eist.service.PersonService#getAllPersons(PersonSortingOptions)`. The template declares it as `List<Person> getAllPersons(PersonSortingOptions sortingOptions)`, matching the problem statement that `GET /persons` returns a list and that sorting must preserve ordering. The solution changes it to `Set<Person> getAllPersons(PersonSortingOptions sortingOptions)`, which discards ordering and also contradicts the resource layer returning `ResponseEntity<List<Person>>`. This mismatch can break compilation between layers and makes the sorting requirement unclear.
issues.suggestedFix: Make `PersonService.getAllPersons(PersonSortingOptions)` return `List<Person>` in the solution (and keep it as a list in the template), returning the sorted list directly (do not convert to `Set`). Ensure `PersonResource.getAllPersons(...)` continues to return `ResponseEntity<List<Person>>` and passes through the list without type conversion.
